paragraphs: GovSkills runs a hiring platform that sits between people who want public service work and the agencies trying to fill those jobs. Applicants pay nothing, and agencies are quoted separately.

The core of the service is translation: dense government postings are turned into wording an ordinary applicant can actually parse. Agencies keep their existing documents, since the platform handles that mapping for them. Matching reads a full resume against a full job description rather than scanning for individual keywords. Listings span city, county, state and federal employers.

The intended audience includes people with no prior government background who find public sector requirements hard to decode. On the hiring side it addresses agencies and associations of any size. The about page lists a small team of founders, a product designer and an engineer, and describes the business as a venture of Citizen Codex.

quote.text: We look at the whole candidate, and the whole role, to see how each individual fits in the complete context of each role’s responsibilities.
